title: Size bound for the width-three-CNF encoding
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits and $g$ gates. The number of clauses in its width-three CNF encoding is at most $3g+1$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit with input dimension n
